grammar.summary: 本课学习过去完成时的叙事用法。

points.title: 过去完成时 had + 过去分词
points.explanation: 过去某点之前已发生：I had asked for a lift, but he... 表两个过去动作的先后（先 asked 后 spoke）。

examples.en: I had had a long and tiring journey.
examples.cn: 我经历了一段漫长而累人的旅程。

points.title: as soon as 与叙事时序
points.explanation: as soon as 表"一……就"：As soon as he had got into the car, I said good morning. 过去完成时在从句中表先发生。

examples.en: As soon as he had got into the car, I spoke to him.
examples.cn: 他一上车，我就跟他说了话。
